note: IP-neutral. Issue #269: a planet's party barge, a big barge floating over the sand that is one long party, a franchise of the town's cantina club. These are the defaults every barge shares; a planet has one only if its own file (content/core/planets/<id>.json) has a "barge" block, which gives it a name, its boss, a home spot, and may override anything here. The cantina's band ('band', in 'band_look') plays the planet's club music on the top deck's stage, open to the bow behind it (the deck runs on over the prow, behind a brass railing) and a DJ plays the lower deck's little rave; the crowd dances on every deck, steerage included, and never stops. Buy it from the boss (boss.price, 5000 credits) or beat him, and it is yours (WorldState flag barge_owned_<planet id>). Until then it is parked at its home and never moves. Perf: the crowd, band, guards and boss are only built when you first come within 'party_m' (one a physics tick, so there is no hitch), and the club's lights and props only animate within 'anim_m'. Its hull and decks are not drawn past 'draw_m' (the wreck field's range for small parts); its home is far enough out that the town never sees it. #269 cleanup: drive it from the control panel at the stern (its status in 'console', its keys on a smaller line under it in 'console_keys'): dial a course, engage, and it goes on autopilot ('drive') while you walk about; it stops dead when it runs into anything, and blows up if it runs into the beast (going faster than 'beast_min_speed'), hurting anyone aboard by 'blast_damage' and coming back at home after 'rebuild_s' seconds of play. Everyone on board has 'person_hp', falls as a ragdoll when killed, and is back after 'respawn_s' seconds of play. Hurt anyone and the crowd and the guards fight back: each kind in 'fighters' becomes that soldier profile where they stand ('rouse_per_tick' a tick), and goes back to dancing once it is over (or after 'calm_back_s'); the band plays on. Only 'armed_share' of the crowd carry a pistol (every other dancer); the rest have none and keep dancing through the fight, still killable. The guards wear 'guard_look' (the guard armour's navy variant). Nothing on board, nor a shot fired within 'off_record_m', changes anyone's standing. The boss wears boss.look (content/look/characters.json; the barge duke, a squid-cyborg the player's height), and bolts find him in a capsule of boss.hit_radius by boss.hit_height. Read by src/systems/world/party_barge.gd; the look is src/systems/world/barge_look.gd.
name: the party barge
crowd_note: Issue #693: 60% of the old crowd (28 to 17): each dancer is a whole body built when you come within party_m, a long frame each. 'crowd' is only the fallback (random clear spots) for a barge without 'crowd_spots'. The open bow: the crowd stands at 'crowd_spots' instead (23, barge-local metres [x, z] on a deck, facing 'face'): four on each dance floor, someone at every table on the top deck, in the lounge and in steerage, and a pair at the bow rail. 'move' mixes the two dances on every floor and table: 'dance' is the cantina's dance, 'groove' dances in place like the guards. 'crowd_looks' are dealt out in spot order: the barge vagabonds (characters.json barge_vagabond, older kit pieces mixed at random), the cantina dancer, the station's locals and the port's.

colors.note: Flat colours for each finish without the look layer (use_look off). With it, barge_look.gd paints them: rusted plates, wood planks, solar panels.

talk: {boss}: Welcome aboard {name}! Nobody stops dancing on MY barge.
{boss}: You want my barge? {price} credits. Or try and take it, little one.
{boss}: Hah! Look at you. Have a drink. Have three.
{boss}: Same band as the cantina, same drinks, better view. I own the franchise.
lines.bought: {boss} snatches your credits and waddles below deck to keep partying. {name} is yours.
lines.boss_hurt: {boss}: OW! Guards! GUARDS! Stop dancing and get them!
lines.boss_beaten: {boss} tumbles below deck, still laughing. {name} is yours.
lines.console_locked: The panel is the boss's. Buy the barge or take it.
lines.console_keys: [A]/[D]  Turn the course     [W]  Engage autopilot     [E]  Step away
lines.console_keys_under_way: [A]/[D]  Turn the course     [S]  All stop     [E]  Step away
lines.engaged: Autopilot engaged. {name} swings round onto its course.
lines.all_stop: All stop. {name} slows to a halt.
lines.let_go: You step away from the panel. The party goes on.
lines.let_go_cruising: You step away from the panel. {name} keeps its course; the party goes on.
lines.blocked: {name} grinds to a dead stop against something. Set a new course.
lines.exploded: {name} hits the beast and goes up in a fireball!
